A class of '''freighter''' was widely used in the centuries following the [[Jedi Civil War]] that featured three engines, an elongated body, and a brownish hull. It was not uncommon during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and later the [[Galactic War]], to see this class of freighter used in combat by third-parties around the galaxy.

==History==
During the Cold War, the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] was able to deploy at least two freighters against the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] above [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TOR:HtGR" />

[[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] mobile [[research vessel|research laboratory]] ''[[Theoretika]]'' was of this class.<ref name="TOR:ARR" />

During the [[Third Galactic War]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] used three ships of this class — the ''[[Champion's Glory]]'', the ''[[Seeker's Vigil]]'' and the ''[[Fortune's Folly]]'' — to [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] [[Mandalore the Avenger]]'s ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]''.<ref name="TOR:SoV" />

==Behind the scenes==
This class of freighter was created for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released in [[2011]], but was never identified by a class-name in-game.<ref name="SWTOR" />
